concept: Refined luxury-jeweler palette for Costello Jewelry Company: a deep emerald primary paired with a champagne-gold accent over soft ivory backgrounds and near-black ink. Timeless, elegant, and trustworthy, with a midnight-navy secondary for depth. Neutrals stay warm and crisp so sparkling jewelry imagery reads vivid and colorful against the surfaces.
contrastNotes: All targets met. ink #14110D on bg #FBF8F2 = 17.76:1 (>=7). ink-soft #595047 on bg = 7.44:1 (>=4.5). white on primary #0E4A39 = 10.21:1 (>=4.5). primary on bg = 9.63:1 (>=3). accent #C7A248 on #000 = 8.69:1 (>=3) for bright pops on dark heroes. Extras: white on primary-dark = 13.52:1; white on secondary #1C2E4A = 13.64:1; secondary on bg = 12.87:1; ink on accent = 7.79:1 for gold-button labels.
